notes: Nucleus-M (WLC-T03) is a modular wireless lens-control (follow-focus/FIZ) kit, not a single fixed-I/O box: 1x Wireless FIZ Hand Unit, 2x Wireless Motors (built-in RF receivers), and 2x wireless handgrips (Focus / Iris+Zoom), packaged together. All external physical connectivity lives on the motors — each has two identical 7-pin LEMO-type locking ports used interchangeably for power-in (D-Tap-to-7-pin cable, included), motor daisy-chain (7-pin-to-7-pin cable, included), or an aftermarket Run/Stop camera-trigger cable (e.g. RS-03-AM, sold separately). No exact "7-pin Lemo" connector id exists in the allowed schema list; xlr4-dc was chosen only as the closest locking DC-power analog — it is not actually an XLR shell, and the port also carries RS-485-style control/daisy-chain data alongside DC power, so treat this mapping as approximate. Confirmed via manufacturer site (tilta.com) that motor DC input is 7.2-24 VDC, matching B&H's spec table exactly. Hand unit and both handgrips are each powered by 2x user-supplied 18650 Li-ion batteries (3.7 VDC) with no external charging port on the units themselves; a separate 4-slot 18650 charger (with its own AC cord) ships in the kit but is a distinct accessory, not part of this device's own I/O. No ports meet any graded connector category (SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/Ethernet), so grade is omitted throughout. Max peak torque 2.5 Nm, 1000 ft wireless range, 3-channel (focus/iris/zoom) control — included for context, not part of physical I/O. Category/type were force-fit to the closest available enum values (control / Other) since this is a cine lens-motor accessory, not a conventional AV control processor.

ports.name: Motor Port 1 (7-Pin)
ports.note: Real connector is a proprietary 7-pin LEMO-type locking connector, not an XLR — closest schema analog for a locking DC-power connector. Carries 7.2-24 VDC motor power plus RS-485-style daisy-chain/control data. Interchangeably used as power input (via included D-Tap-to-7-pin cable), motor-to-motor daisy chain (7-pin-to-7-pin cable), or a Run/Stop camera-trigger cable.

ports.name: Motor Port 2 (7-Pin)
ports.note: Second, identical 7-pin LEMO-type port on the same motor; functionally interchangeable with Motor Port 1 (power/daisy-chain/R-S).
